ValidationRule.description: Validation to check if Email value is provided in proper format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', NOT ISBLANK( Email ) , NOT REGEX( Email , "^[a-zA-Z0-9.'+-]{2,}@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{2,}.[a-zA-Z]{2,}$" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Email in correct format.
